# Lyrenza Barcelona Eixample

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Barcelona Eixample is in Barcelona, Spain, in the Europe region.
Facilities: Rooftop pool; tapas restaurant; fitness studio; family rooms. Pool or water-facility hours: 08:00-21:00.
Parking: Partner garage; EUR 32 nightly. Transportation: Metro station is a three-minute walk.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
